profile.nameJa: モアブ人／モアブの勢力
profile.subtitleJa: イスラエルの隣接勢力
profile.summaryJa: 士師記3章12節では、主がモアブの王エグロンを強め、イスラエルに敵対させたと記されます。ここでのモアブは人物名ではなく、王権とその民を指す集団名です。
profile.identityNoteJa: 士師記の「モアブ」は、民や王権を指す用例と、地・国境を指す用例があります。ここでは民・政治勢力として読める箇所を扱い、「モアブの地」などの地理用法は除いています。

facts.textJa: 3章14節でイスラエルはエグロンに18年間仕え、15節と17節ではエフドが貢ぎ物を携えて王のもとへ行きます。
3章28節でエフドはモアブ人を敵と呼び、29–30節では彼らが打たれ、モアブがイスラエルの手に屈したと記されます。
10章6節はイスラエルがモアブの神々にも仕えたと述べます。
11章15節でエフタはイスラエルがモアブの地を奪わなかったと述べ、17節ではモアブの王が通行を拒んだと語ります。
11章25節でエフタは、モアブの王バラクを引き合いに出します。

profile.historicalRoleJa: イスラエルの隣接する民・王国。

wikipedia.title: Moab
wikipedia.noteJa: この記事は古代のモアブ王国とその地域を扱います。士師記中の民・王権の用法と関連する資料として示し、記事の地理的主張や系譜を本文の事実として採用していません。

primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: The children of Israel again did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, and the LORD strengthened Eglon the king of Moab against Israel, because they had done that which was evil in the LORD’s sight.
The children of Israel served Eglon the king of Moab eighteen years.

But when the children of Israel cried to the LORD, the LORD raised up a savior for them: Ehud the son of Gera, the Benjamite, a left-handed man. The children of Israel sent tribute by him to Eglon the king of Moab.
He offered the tribute to Eglon king of Moab. Now Eglon was a very fat man.

He said to them, “Follow me; for the LORD has delivered your enemies the Moabites into your hand.” They followed him, and took the fords of the Jordan against the Moabites, and didn’t allow any man to pass over.
They struck at that time about ten thousand men of Moab, every strong man and every man of valor. No man escaped.
So Moab was subdued that day under the hand of Israel. Then the land had rest eighty years.

The children of Israel again did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, and served the Baals, the Ashtaroth, the gods of Syria, the gods of Sidon, the gods of Moab, the gods of the children of Ammon, and the gods of the Philistines. They abandoned the LORD, and didn’t serve him.
and he said to him, “Jephthah says: Israel didn’t take away the land of Moab, nor the land of the children of Ammon;

then Israel sent messengers to the king of Edom, saying, ‘Please let me pass through your land;’ but the king of Edom didn’t listen. In the same way, he sent to the king of Moab, but he refused; so Israel stayed in Kadesh.
Now are you anything better than Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab? Did he ever strive against Israel, or did he ever fight against them?
